items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But Kilman puts in a thing like that sometimes. [INTERVIEWEE] Lead and Savvy. Yeah. I heard nobody else played that thing since Eddie died.

ctx.x: See, like he said, come right on down with that note. Like these fellas, there's a number of, there plays around here. We play it all the time, son.
But Kilman puts in a thing like that sometimes.
Lead and Savvy. Yeah. I heard nobody else played that thing since Eddie died.
